method: Independent direct arithmetic from canonical scalars and raw pooled diets; no engine import or construction

assumptions.m0_formula: P * (1 - source_EE) before floor; P * (1 - max(source_EE, 0.1)) after floor
assumptions.external_sink_formula: M0_pre_floor - M0_effective; excluded from detritus inflow
assumptions.egestion_formula: Q * GS for feeding consumers; GS 0.2 default, 0.4 only for actual small-zooplankton group; none is present here
assumptions.nonfeeding_Q: Structural zero for source pp=1 groups; source missing Q/B preserved
assumptions.missing_landings: Runtime zero assumption only; original missing scalar and absence from source fleet table are retained and flagged
assumptions.missing_detritus_import_export_BA: Not treated as measurements; the reported pool residual is prior to any assumed import/export or closure BA
assumptions.fishery_discards: Sum living group fleet discard quantities once as an internal return to the sole detritus pool; no duplication as group70 source_discards or biomass
assumptions.pool_self_routing: 100% authorized; no additional pool turnover/BA/export synthesized by this independent arithmetic
assumptions.EE_scope: 69 non-detrital groups; pooled EE remains source-unknown; this file does not apply a runtime detrital EE default

fin_whale.full_outflow_residual_definition: P - predation - landings - fishery discards - M0_effective_to_detritus - EE_floor_external_nonfishery_sink
